why: Restore the inside-the-club area at Empathy and reissue its verified ambient bouncers, staff and patrons as the venue streams in. The top floor is open in the cooked default.

open_questions: The three default-state communities are already activated at boot by the kept vanilla phase base/open_world/community/city_centre/downtown/phases/cct_dtn_phase.questphase, and the gate analysis marks those activations ungated, so the extract says the club is populated in the clean slate. The risk this proposal addresses is playbook rule 6: that boot activation runs before the club interior (exterior sector -13_3_0_1 and neighbours) has streamed, which is the classic empty-venue failure. Check on the tour whether the club was empty before this phase; if it was already populated, the re-issue is redundant but harmless, and if it stays empty the problem is elsewhere (the section that owns the spawners not streaming).

interior_area polarity/need: 1 is chosen because the node is a worldInteriorAreaNode with NoJump/InDaClub and the wiki notes jumping is disabled when visiting outside quests, but the sector's enabledByDefault is 0 and vanilla sets both 0 and 1 within one phase. Cosmetic only; first thing to eyeball on the tour.

#dtn_03_crowd_com has no resolved path or entries. Confirm it is the generic pavement crowd around the club (most likely, given the crowd_off trigger and restricted guard area) and not a second club crowd that the boot activation is supposed to switch on.
The venue's owners Adam Ibrahimovic and Larry Fanghorn exist only as gig characters; this venue has no spawn set for them, so they are absent. Adding either would be a cast-layer/owner decision.

We leave it powered, so the ordinary scanner runs; confirm it does not block or trap the player at the door (the wiki says entering through the main door requires relinquishing weapons during the gig).
The upstairs bar (#dtn_03_ws_barman_001, z=12.1) is 'unusable' per the wiki; vanilla still posts a barman there in the default crowd. Check he is not standing behind a dead counter.

The alert/scene entries we do not re-issue are still switched on by the kept boot activation. On the tour, check that no leftover gig-scene actor (manager, prostitutes, security locker officer) appears: those belong to the unloaded #sts_cct_dtn_03_streetstory section, so the expected result is none.

variant_toggles.why: The inside-the-club state. Variant 1 streams the worldInteriorAreaNode {sts_cct_dtn_03_interior_area}, which applies GameplayRestriction.InDaClub and NoJump and treatAsInterior for the club volume, so the club behaves like an interior (no street ambience in the room, no jumping) while the player is inside it. Vanilla sets 1 when V is inside and 0 on the way out; the sector's baked default is off, so the venue phase sets the ordinary state. Feel/cosmetic switch only - it affects no spawn. Full $/ path because the node name is an untagged _prefab ref.

deferred_prefab_owner: world streaming (the chosen people need no quest prefab)

Every visitor passes it before the reception and the main floor, it is a device and not a door or workspot (rule 8), and it streams with the exterior sector. The venue phase does not power it off, so the entrance scan stays vanilla.
